content.short: Kiln is an enterprise-grade staking-as-a-service platform providing secure and non-custodial staking solutions.
content.description:
Kiln is the leading enterprise-grade staking platform, designed to provide secure and transparent staking-as-a-service for institutional and retail participants. The platform offers both dedicated staking for users with large holdings and pooled staking for smaller amounts, managing billions of dollars in staked assets across major networks including Ethereum, Solana, and Polygon. Kiln is the primary staking partner for prominent wallets and exchanges like Ledger and Coinbase Cloud, serving as a vital bridge between traditional financial entities and decentralized networks.

Fully non-custodial and SOC 2 Type II certified, Kiln ensures that users maintain full control over their assets while the platform handles the complexities of validator infrastructure. The protocol is built for high reliability and security, utilizing professional-grade monitoring and reporting tools to optimize validator performance. By providing a seamless and compliant staking experience, Kiln is empowering the next generation of digital asset managers to participate in the decentralized economy with confidence.
content.meta: Kiln offers secure, enterprise-grade, non-custodial staking solutions for institutional and retail participants across multiple chains.
